meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 它会用 workflow 工具按依赖顺序驱动子任务:一次运行只覆盖一个阶段的依赖波次;节点按 category 分派,依赖清空后分波并行执行,已完成节点的缓存会被复用。单个失败节点可单独重试、追加指令或改动定义重跑。
howto.when: 当你提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG,或要求做存在真实依赖的分批并行任务(例如 C 需等 A、B 完成)时触发。运行由 ulw-loop 或 ulw-execute 管辖目标与验收。

say.text: 看看这个 DAG 现在跑到哪了,哪些节点失败了
只重试 lint 节点,提示词改成跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: 失败节点单独重跑一次

howto.what_en: It drives dependency-ordered child work via the workflow tool: one run per phase, nodes routed by category into parallel waves as dependencies clear, reusing finished nodes' cache. A bad node can be retried, steered, or amended.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG, or staged fan-out work with real dependencies (C needs A and B first). ulw-loop or ulw-execute owns goals and acceptance.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to define a DAG: audit, then rewrite, then verify
say_en.note: Builds the graph and starts one run

say_en.text: Where is this DAG now, and which nodes failed?
Retry only the lint node, and change its prompt to skip vendored dirs
